availabilityBasis: Latest recorded revision of the original published Zenodo 1.10 archive; not observation date or sample GitHub commit.
calendarAssumption: Published static crop-area-weighted day-of-year calendar recurs in target year; not a measured planting date.
downloadMethod: Only original ES table byte ranges; each member CRC verified. Full 6.2GB archive not downloaded.

historicalCybenchBoundary.role: Historical source verification only. Original polygons are not redistributed as selection geometry. Weather/crop-mask/calendar inputs and original model training provenance are unchanged.

samplePublicationNotUsed: GitHub sample commit b55e691 is 2026-04-16, after these pre-season issue dates.

selectionBoundary.attribution: Obra derivada de Unidades Administrativas (IGN), consulta 2026-11-15, CC-BY 4.0 ign.es
selectionBoundary.crosswalk_basis: CY-Bench ES112 is Lugo (NUTS 2016), matched to official IGN province 27 Lugo by reviewed identity; not a new weather aggregation
selectionBoundary.crosswalk_method: Official IGN nationalCode: country 34, autonomous-community 2 digits, province INE 2 digits, municipal suffix 00000. Exact 01–50 code match to the reviewed MAPA keys; names retained independently.
selectionBoundary.point_definition: Fixed NASA POWER sampling points from province-monthly-v1; unchanged; verified inside official IGN province geometry; not crop-area weighted

point_provenance.current_check: Containment in independently sourced IGN geometry; no point recomputation
point_provenance.original_selection: Shapely representative interior point of GISCO NUTS 2024 province geometry

precision_policy.area_method: pyproj.Geod WGS84 ellipsoid; oriented polygon rings
precision_policy.use: Province lookup/selection, not cadastral or surveyed field boundaries

selectionBoundary.province_names_source: MAPA provisional 2025 official provincial database PRO_ID/PRO_DESCRIPCION

temporalInterpretation: Retrospective estimates computed during release preparation, not evidence of forecasts actually issued on the nominal January/April dates.
weatherLimit: Observed daily data through 2023. Pre-season climatology uses five eligible 2019-2023 seasons; there is no 2026 mid-season weather.
